class="how-it-works__text"><h2 class="how-it-works__title fs-5">How it works</h2><p class="how-it-works__desc fs-3">Flawless App is integrated right inside your iOS simulator as a plugin. It allows you to fix visual issues on the fly, before they cost you time and money.</p><p class="how-it-works__desc fs-3">No need to distract your development workflow by adding any third-party library.
